title: ClickSight: An LLM Framework for Interpreting Student Clickstreams Through Learning Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2611.02021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital learning environments produce rich clickstream data that can reveal how students approach learning tasks, yet interpreting these fine-grained traces often requires substantial expert effort. We introduce ClickSight, a framework for interpreting student clickstreams through learning strategies defined in the literature. Given a student clickstream and a predefined set of learning strategies, ClickSight uses a staged LLM-based pipeline to identify strategy-relevant evidence, assess adherence to each strategy, and generate an evidence-grounded interpretation of the student's behavior. We evaluate ClickSight across two learning environments, 365 students, and 12 model backbones using an expert-grounded quality rubric and an LLM judge calibrated with human-expert ratings. translated_title: ClickSight：一种通过学习策略解读学生点击流数据的大语言模型框架
translated_abstract: 数字学习环境会产生丰富的点击流数据，这些数据能够揭示学生如何开展学习任务，然而解读这些细粒度的行为轨迹通常需要大量的专家投入。我们提出了ClickSight，一个基于文献中定义的学习策略来解读学生点击流的框架。给定学生的点击流数据和一组预定义的学习策略，ClickSight使用分阶段的大语言模型流水线来识别与策略相关的证据、评估学生对每种策略的遵循程度，并生成基于证据的学生行为解读。我们在两个学习环境、365名学生和12种模型骨干上，采用基于专家的质量评估标准以及经过人类专家评分校准的LLM评审方法对ClickSight进行了评估。结果表明，ClickSight能够在不同模型和环境中生成高质量的基于策略的解读，其中推理模型表现更为出色。
tldr: ClickSight是一个基于大语言模型的分阶段框架，能够依据文献中定义的学习策略自动解读学生点击流数据，并生成高质量、有证据支撑的学习行为解读。
en_tdlr: ClickSight is a staged LLM-based framework that automatically interprets student clickstreams through literature-defined learning strategies, generating high-quality, evidence-grounded interpretations of student learning behavior across diverse models and environments.
